Dispatch

Transit estimates
Standard shipping is estimated at 3 to 7 days. This range is an estimate, not a guarantee, and cannot establish an exact arrival date without a verified dispatch anchor. A carrier estimate from current tracking records takes precedence when available. Do not invent a missing carrier estimate.

Tracking
Order and carrier event records establish shipment state. Report the latest event and timestamp. With no carrier event for 5 or more calendar days at the scenario date, mark tracking stale; it is not proof of loss or delivery. Escalate unresolved cases rather than inventing a live update.

results.text:
Delayed shipments
Use current tracking events and shipping policy to explain delays. A delay alone does not prove refund eligibility. Above-threshold amounts require review even when a parcel is delayed. Escalate unresolved delivery/refund requests with evidence references; never guarantee compensation.

Window
Returns use calendar days from verified delivery, inclusive on the final day. The default return window is 30 days. Footwear and apparel have 30-day windows, home products have 30 days, and electronics have 15 days. An undelivered order has not started its return window. The earlier reported 60-day window is not current; use this version and disclose the discrepancy.

Exceptions
Requests for an exception on an ineligible item require human review. Product injury or safety complaints always require safety escalation. This agent provides eligibility information; it does not create returns or issue refunds.

Review threshold
The configured automatic-review threshold is $100. Refund amounts above $100 require human review; the agent cannot bypass that threshold. ref:c3181ffefc9c0f6c47e7's $250 knife set therefore requires review. At or below $100, eligibility still requires verified records and all applicable return rules. The evaluated agent issues no refunds at any amount.

Condition
For review, provide the order reference and describe the item condition. The agent must not infer condition or approve an exception. Eligibility is computed from the verified order and configured rules, not a customer-supplied delivery date.

Exclusions
Perishable grocery products, including the Gourmet Cheese Box, are excluded from returns. No live-animal, kayak or other unlisted-product-specific policy is defined. Missing policy requires clarification or abstention, not a generic eligibility promise.

Methods
Refund-method and processing-time details are not defined in this synthetic corpus. Do not invent payment destinations or processing durations; refer to human support for those details.
